issue_request: FHIR-50860 was Applied as Persuasive with Modification for R6. It requested that the FHIR NPM package specification say packages SHOULD contain an ImplementationGuide resource at {package-canonical}/ImplementationGuide/{packageId} with a version matching the package version, and that tooling may resolve a canonical reference to an implementation guide resource as the matching NPM FHIR Package.
